reviews.summary: Independent artifact inspection and two executable checks: deterministic output passes, unseen-animal acceptance fails. No producer rationale, histories, ledger tests or other demos read.

findings.evidence: evaluation.py lines 1-5 split repeated visits by row. Ledger.check observed identical train/test animal sets [animal-a, animal-b], reported accuracy 1.0, and failed disjointness assertion (exit 1).
findings.impact: Every evaluated animal was seen in training; the dictionary retrieves its prior target. Accuracy does not establish prediction on unseen animals.
findings.verification: Partition by animal identity and rerun an explicit train/test ID-disjointness assertion and evaluation on held-out animals.

findings.evidence: evaluation.py lines 4-7 implement and print only identity-lookup accuracy. No separate simple baseline is provided. Independent check computed a training-majority constant baseline accuracy of 0.5 on the current test rows.
findings.impact: The requested baseline comparison is absent; the reported 1.0 cannot establish added predictive value.
findings.verification: Provide and report a simple baseline fitted exclusively on training labels, scored on the same corrected held-out animals as the candidate. Repeat execution to confirm reproducible results.
